page.layout: One page of text in a single column of italic verse; margin note at lower right, beside the last lines.

p.i: Seu cum decoro fquallidum te puluere Mirata quondam eft Rufcino Solum feroces bellicofa libera Parma morantem exercitus, Tunc cum tuorum fida caftrorum comes Attonita virtus par nouum Spectauit, hinc virum, inde bellum, & horruit Quod fecerat fpectaculum.
Vercella pectus una follicitat meum, Vercella fola macerat, Vercella vita Gallijs dum vincitur Felicior victricibus.
Virtute tanta comminus cui perfrui Indulsit Astrorum fauor. Inusitato quam theatrum calites Elegerint spectaculo:

Cum te chorago pace cum placida feram Mars copulauit dexteram: Bellona mitis frena legum pertulit, Innoxioq; fœdere Vis æquitati iuncta, ius licentiæ Secura pressit compita, Saluoque recti & improbi discrimine Castris forum se miscuit.
Quem nuper inter arma fossarum mora, Celsaque pinnarum mina, Tot stricta tela, plumbeaq; grandinis Procella non exterruit,

page.notes: Lines of the first stanza with "Quod fecerat" and the line "Quem" are underlined in the print. A decorative sign stands before "Astrorum" and before "Mars". "vita" (stanza 2) is doubtful: the print reads "viEta" or similar, [?] not marked on the word because the sense is clear. "stricta" and "mina" are doubtful readings. "Gallijs" is copied as printed. The "Idem" note is a marginal note beside the last line.
